title: Add WebView summary tile quick links
summary: Add read-only quick-link behavior to WebView status tiles, metric cards, live-run chips, and summary surfaces so operators can jump to the related page, tab, filter, or focus target without invoking commands.
reason: Summary tiles already present high-signal operational state; making accepted read-only surfaces navigable reduces operator friction while preserving backend ownership of scans, launches, publishes, repairs, and media mutation.
behavior_before: Home, Metrics, Queue, Completed, Pending, Reports, Network, Launch, Maintenance, Schedule, and live-run summary surfaces displayed status but most did not navigate, filter, or focus their related detail views when clicked.
behavior_after: Accepted summary surfaces expose accessible quick links via data-ui-quick-link attributes and shared WebView lifecycle handling. Clicks and keyboard activation only navigate, switch tabs, focus panels, or apply existing display filters; command-only actions remain untouched.
manual_validation: git diff --check for scoped quick-link files - passed with existing LF/CRLF warnings
